paper_title: Axion Dark Matter eXperiment around 3.3 μeV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitsky Discovery Ability
notes: ADMX 2022 run excluding DFSZ axions between 3.27-3.34 ueV (792-807 MHz) at 90% CL, MB distribution with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The exclusion reaches the DFSZ line (gamma coupling g_gamma=-0.97, gaγγ ~ 3.9e-16 GeV^-1 at ~3.3 ueV). Data points are approximate; the limit dips below DFSZ across most of the band. Precise per-mass values only available from Fig. 4 which is not machine-readable.
